spec_features.spec_quote: stop early if model emits a terminal "give up / done" signal
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py:229-235 give_up oracle returns ToolResult(terminal=True); agent.py:127-130 sets gave_up=True on res.terminal and stop_reason='gave_up' then break. terminal_regex also wired at agent.py:116-118.
spec_features.notes: give_up tool dispatched and honored as a hard stop; terminal regex (DEFAULT_TERMINAL_REGEXES) also compiled and matched in free text and breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: calling this is not automatically a failure
spec_features.evidence: judge.py:213-223: on stop_reason=='gave_up', if reason_len>=120 and not early -> gave_up_gracefully=True, aband=0; metrics.py:57-58 splits gave_up into graceful vs bad.
spec_features.notes: Giving up with a substantive reason is scored gracefully (abandonment=0), not collapse; this branches on the reason length and turn timing.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # abandonment: gave up with budget left AND without a substantive reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS default 12 (cheap; empirically enough to enter a spiral if a model will)
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:84 `for turn in range(config.max_turns)`; LoopConfig.max_turns=12 (agent.py:43); plumbed via runner.py:78 and cli.py:55.
spec_features.notes: Loop is bounded by max_turns; default stop_reason='max_turns'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Agent loop budget. Short by design: cheap & fast, enough to reveal onset.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early stop when the model calls give_up, or emits a configurable terminal regex, or produces N consecutive empty/near-duplicate turns
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:116-118 terminal_regex break; :127-130 give_up break; :104-110 degenerate_streak tracking and :132-134 `if degenerate_streak >= config.degenerate_streak_stop` (default 3) break.
spec_features.notes: All three early-stop conditions are checked and break the loop with distinct stop_reasons.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps: MAX_TURNS, max_tokens per call, total --budget-usd kill-switch
spec_features.evidence: max_tokens passed to client.complete (agent.py:90) and used by providers (openai_client.py:80, anthropic_client.py:79). Budget: runner.py:150-156 accumulates spent['usd']+=rec.usage.cost_usd and if plan.budget_usd and spent>=budget sets stop_flag; :163-176 break submission loop on stop_flag.
spec_features.notes: All three caps enforced. Budget only stops submitting NEW runs (in-flight runs finish); cost_usd computed per provider via estimate_cost; mock returns cost 0 so budget never triggers offline, but openai/anthropic paths populate it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Total spend kill-switch in USD (0 = unlimited). Stops submitting new runs once hit.
